question: The controller's pass-08 decision REC-36 item (7) authorizes an 'acceptance-corpus rebind (CF-32)' for the single rev14 revision. Nobody has measured whether that rebind SUFFICES: at the live FROZEN rev29 / rev13 pins, does regenerating the rebased semantic-escape corpus with the pinned generator restore ACCEPTANCE: PASS, or does a content-level union escape survive the rebind?
why_bounded: Read-only outside artifacts/worker-069/. Every execution of the pinned tools (measure_semantic_escape.py, run_acceptance.py, check_class_schema.py, spec_conformance_audit.py) happens inside sandbox copies of the pinned inputs; the instrument never runs the live copies of the mutating tools and never writes a canonical path.

inputs_and_pins.schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml.sha256: declares 1bb78ce9b3572cdac229ad7623ce96908bf4f08dc62c3c6264d97b17c0355508 (stale sidecar, census only, not a pipeline input)

preregistered_predicates.P0_pin_guard: Every pinned input measures its preregistered sha256 at run start and at run end; any mismatch aborts the run (CF-27 moving-target rule). The pinned fixture's declared base_sha256 (1bb78ce9b357) differs from the live C0 schema (b2ab6acb2bbe).
preregistered_predicates.P1_baseline_preflight: sandbox_base run_acceptance.py exits 3 and prints 'PREFLIGHT FAIL: rebased fixtures are stale' naming corpus base 1bb78ce9b3572cdac229ad7623ce96908bf4f08dc62c3c6264d97b17c0355508 and current base b2ab6acb2bbe7f86903e4d41082a4aa4ff19149d5d6fc7206aad5aa861b4501c; it writes no acceptance_pipeline_report.json.
preregistered_predicates.P2_regeneration: sandbox_rebind_a run of the pinned measure_semantic_escape.py exits 0, emits a fixture whose base_sha256 == live C0, mutants_rebased == 31, unparsed == 1, controls_false_positive == 0; the emitted rebased_fixtures directory contains exactly 33 .yaml files (31 mutants + 2 controls).
preregistered_predicates.P3_determinism: A second independent sandbox (sandbox_rebind_b) regenerates a byte-identical fixture (same sha256) and the same summary.
preregistered_predicates.P4_rebind_sufficiency: After regeneration, sandbox_rebind_a run_acceptance.py exits 0, prints 'ACCEPTANCE: PASS', canonical rows are 3/3 ok, controls 2/2 ok, mutants.total == 31 and mutants.union_caught == 31.
preregistered_predicates.P5_collateral: No live canonical file changes during the run; the live artifacts/formulation/evidence/rebased_fixtures directory file set is unchanged (the instrument only reads pins).
preregistered_predicates.P6_binding_census: For each pipeline input the census classifies pin status: FROZEN.files pin / recorded-inside-a-pinned-artifact / unpinned. The 33-fixture rebased_fixtures directory and the stage-B auditor are expected to be load-bearing but not directly FROZEN-pinned.
preregistered_predicates.P7_sidecar_advisory: schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml.sha256 is a stale, unbound sidecar (declares 1bb78ce9) and no pipeline tool reads a .sha256 sidecar; reported as advisory, not as a P4 blocker.

decision_rule.if_P4_holds: Verdict REBIND_SUFFICES_AT_MEASURED_BASE: authorized item (7) restores acceptance at the measured base, and the remaining rev14 risk is a C0 byte move (any C0 change re-opens the rebind and re-requires P1-P4).
decision_rule.if_P4_fails: Verdict REBIND_INSUFFICIENT_AT_MEASURED_BASE: enumerate every union escape with its canonical and stage-B verdicts/failed_rules and report it as a gate-relevant finding, because a byte move voids all current verdicts (REC-36) and the rev14 freeze must not land believing the rebind is sufficient.
decision_rule.if_pins_drift: Verdict VOID_BY_DRIFT: report the drifted path and stop; no sufficiency statement is made.

controls.CTL-1_reproduction: baseline sandbox reproduces the live failure text (P1).
controls.CTL-2_field_sensitivity: a copy with one hex character flipped in the fixture base_sha256 still fails preflight but names the flipped declared hash, proving the field is read.
controls.CTL-3_negative: the regenerated sandbox passes preflight (precondition of P4).
controls.CTL-4_parser_guard: regeneration reports exactly 1 unparsed mutation, matching the pinned fixture.
controls.CTL-5_pin_guard_selftest: the pin-guard helper rejects a synthetic file whose measured hash differs from the expected hash.
controls.CTL-6_unbound_input_load_bearing: in a throwaway regenerated sandbox, deleting one mutant fixture changes mutants.total (and still yields PASS), demonstrating that the unpinned rebased_fixtures directory is load-bearing and does not fail closed.
controls.CTL-8_read_only: live pin hashes and the live rebased_fixtures listing are identical before and after (P5).

non_claims: Not a gate verdict and not a node transition: G-FORM and F2b status remain the controller's and the leads' to set.
Not a mathematics claim about strong cosmic censorship or any class predicate.
Binds only the pins above; any byte move in FROZEN/schemas/tools/fixture voids the binding, not the checks.
Does not adjudicate the REC-41 stage-B R03 binder defect; if an escape carries R03, that causal attribution is reported only as measured failed_rules.
Does not write, repair or re-pin any canonical artifact; the rebind is executed only inside sandbox copies.
falsifier: Re-run artifacts/worker-069/f2b_acceptance_rebind_coverage/check_rebind_coverage.py on byte-identical pinned inputs. This coverage measurement is falsified if: (a) P1 does not reproduce (sandbox baseline exits 0 or names different hashes); (b) the regenerated fixture does not bind the live C0 or is not byte-deterministic across the two independent sandboxes; (c) any recorded predicate verdict flips on the same bytes; (d) ACCEPTANCE: PASS is reached but a mutant recorded as caught is in fact an escape under the pinned tools; or (e) any pinned input hash differs at re-measurement (drift voids the binding, not the checks).
